title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมมาตรา 1659 แห่งประมวลกฎหมายปกครอง (ฉบับแก้ไข) ซึ่งแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมแล้ว
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Pasal 1659 Kitab Undang-Undang Administrasi (Revisi) sebagaimana diubah
title.ms: Akta meminda Seksyen 1659 Kanun Pentadbiran (Semakan) sebagaimana dipinda

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1953/ra_945_1953.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: To carry out the purposes of this Act and in addition to such sum as may have been provided for under current appropriation, there is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated the amount of twenty-two thousand nine hundred pesos for the fiscal year nineteen hundred and fifty-four.

This Act shall take effect on July first, nineteen hundred and fifty-three.
Approved, June 20, 1953.
